gnhf terminal resize evidence

Media note: PNG rasterization may clip some box-drawing strokes. Original VT bytes and Unicode cell text are retained in terminal-captures.zip; the complete title is present there. These artifacts are terminal replays, not desktop screenshots.

Fresh macOS execution using Node 24.13.0. These are captured PTY bytes interpreted by xterm/headless 6.0.0 with Unicode 11, rendered cell for cell. They are terminal replays, not desktop recordings. The demo uses the built-in offline mode. The Git run uses the real CLI, renderer, orchestrator and Git, with an isolated synthetic provider protocol fixture.

Scope: delivered macOS resize notifications, including dispatch delayed by a synchronous Git hook. Windows was not run. A Windows shrink-and-return entirely missed by libuv remains outside this fix. No periodic repainting was added. Refs #166.

Demo: initial 120 × 40
